searchText: **Here's my talk on eip1559 on Filecoin** - hopefully it's useful to folks here - happy to work together more on this later on - would appreciate any feedback, specially if i got anything wrong - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ABhyJXxTnJY - Yeah, it was in one part because we didnt have a solution to SSLE 3 years ago, and also because we think we can get more throughput with tipsets (though right now the binding constraint is verification time, not propagation delay -- once we make verification faster, we expect propagation delay to be a bigger problem) - <@!273808422753796097> Yes! we've seen some of the solutions for SSLE -- great work! 👍 - We may move to using SSLE in next iterations of the chain. we're not using it now because this design got frozen ~1.5yr ago so that we would ship it "soon". - We hope to make a bunch of upgrades to consensus in 2021 and 2022, and moving to SSLE is likely one (especially if we dont get any throughput out of tipsets) There definitely are benefits from having parallel proposers; reduced censorship vulnerability is one So if you decide the benefits of parallel proposing exceed the costs, then it may well be the case that SSLE to have a constant proposer count is not worth the complexity But you know better than me what's good for filecoin 😄

excerpts.author: jbenet.
excerpts.content:
**Here's my talk on eip1559 on Filecoin**
- hopefully it's useful to folks here
- happy to work together more on this later on
- would appreciate any feedback, specially if i got anything wrong
- https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ABhyJXxTnJY

excerpts.author: jbenet.
excerpts.content: - Yeah, it was in one part because we didnt have a solution to SSLE 3 years ago, and also because we think we can get more throughput with tipsets (though right now the binding constraint is verification time, not propagation delay -- once we make verification faster, we expect propagation delay to be a bigger problem)

excerpts.author: jbenet.
excerpts.content:
- <@!273808422753796097>  Yes! we've seen some of the solutions for SSLE -- great work! 👍 
- We may move to using SSLE in next iterations of the chain. we're not using it now because this design got frozen ~1.5yr ago so that we would ship it "soon". 
- We hope to make a bunch of upgrades to consensus in 2021 and 2022, and moving to SSLE is likely one (especially if we dont get any throughput out of tipsets)

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: There definitely are benefits from having parallel proposers; reduced censorship vulnerability is one

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: So if you decide the benefits of parallel proposing exceed the costs, then it may well be the case that SSLE to have a constant proposer count is not worth the complexity

excerpts.author: .vbuterin
excerpts.content: But you know better than me what's good for filecoin 😄
